exact_statement: For every finite uniform-cube Boolean sign and queried physical block A, define Gamma_A=sum_T q_T log2(E_a w_T(a)^4/q_T^2) on positive-q retained rows and V_A=B_A+Gamma_A. Then 0<=J_A<=Gamma_A<=|A|, L_A<=V_A, Gamma is additive under disjoint tensor products with aligned queried blocks, and Gamma=0 exactly when all squared child row coefficients coincide. Its exact signed convolution representation is sum_T q_T log2(1+sum_(V nonempty)(sum_U fhat(U,T)fhat(U xor V,T))^2/q_T^2). For n>=2, K_col(n)=max_f min_(nonempty proper A,I_A>0) V_A/I_A satisfies M_n<=K_col(n)<=n M_n/(n-1), where M_n is the finite maximum of H/I on at most n bits. Therefore lim K_col(n)=sup M_n as extended reals. A least-essential-dimension fixed-K violating witness exists whenever any such violation exists, and every proper block satisfies V_A>=K I_A+D_K(f). On the exact named six-bit NAND case0006, mask48 uniquely satisfies V_A/I_A<R(f), with V_A/I_A<47/20<12/5<R(f), while every singleton cost exceeds 319/100; its nonconstant physical child has positive root-ratio deficit. These are finite certificates and structural identities, not a universal FEI payment theorem.
